## Nhắc công nợ tăng dần qua WhatsApp
**Làm gì:** Đọc bảng công nợ trong Sheets, gửi nhắc lần 1, 2, 3 với giọng tăng dần theo số ngày quá hạn.
**Trigger:** Lịch (Schedule)
**Credential cần:** Google Sheets
**Chi phí ước:** Gần 0 + phí tin WhatsApp.
**Mở rộng gợi ý:** Dịch mẫu tin sang tiếng Việt; đổi kênh sang Zalo hoặc email; nối module hoá đơn.

---
**Nguồn:** Kho awesome-n8n-templates (Enes Cingoz tổng hợp, giấy phép CC BY 4.0)
https://github.com/enescingoz/awesome-n8n-templates/blob/main/WhatsApp/Send%20Escalating%20WhatsApp%20Invoice%20Reminders%20from%20Google%20Sheets%20(Hebrew).json
Nhãn TAG: **Recommend** (chọn lọc theo DNA khoá, học viên tự import; TAG đổi nhãn khi test xong).
Import: n8n → Create workflow → ⋯ → Import from file. Sau khi import, mở từng node đỏ để chọn credential của bạn.

## Send Escalating WhatsApp Invoice Reminders from Google Sheets (Hebrew)

### How it works

This workflow runs every morning at 09:00 to check a Google Sheet for open invoices. It calculates whether each invoice is exactly 7, 14, or 30 days overdue and builds the matching Hebrew reminder message. Matching reminders are sent through a WAHA WhatsApp HTTP endpoint, then the invoice row is updated in Google Sheets to record the sent reminder.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Sheets credentials in n8n and point the read node to the spreadsheet and sheet containing open invoices.
- Ensure the invoice sheet includes the fields expected by the code node, such as due date, customer phone number, invoice details, and reminder status columns.
- Update the WAHA HTTP request URL from https://YOUR-WAHA-SERVER/api/sendText to your actual WAHA server endpoint and configure any required authentication headers.
- Verify the schedule trigger timezone so 09:00 matches the intended local morning time.
- Test with sample invoices that are exactly 7, 14, and 30 days overdue to confirm message formatting and row updates.

### Customization

Adjust the code node to change overdue tiers, Hebrew message wording, phone-number formatting, or filtering rules. The schedule can also be changed if reminders should be sent at a different time or frequency.

## Schedule and read invoices

Starts the workflow every morning at 09:00 and pulls the current list of open invoices from Google Sheets. These two left-side nodes form the intake cluster for the daily reminder run.

## Calculate reminder tier

Filters the invoice data to the items that are exactly 7, 14, or 30 days overdue and prepares the appropriate Hebrew WhatsApp reminder message for each matching invoice.

## Send and record reminders

Sends each prepared reminder through the WAHA WhatsApp API, then updates Google Sheets to mark that the reminder was sent.
